blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the current front, back, side, three-quarter, and six pose renders shows strong angular faceting and wrinkled clumps across the skirt, with uneven, pointed split-front edges. The overall skirt silhouette is not visually continuous.

Current sit and crouch renders expose large rounded shorts-like thigh shells through and ahead of the overskirt. The front lap/apron panels separate into narrow pointed flaps and leave the seated anterior thighs visibly uncovered; the current pose geometry is not acceptable.

The rear waist adjustment tab is only a small, low-contrast shape in the full-body back view and is not visually legible as a distinct functional-looking detail. It needs a readable silhouette and close-up evidence.

Direct raster inspection of the source-bound partial UV chart shows dense near-continuous vertical line stacks crossing the unit tile, with panel islands crowded and difficult to distinguish. This is not a reviewable production UV layout. The chart contains only authored UVs from 21/25 mesh objects; the plastron and three front fasteners are explicitly unmapped and omitted. No UV coordinates were generated or substituted.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
